function checkSendTransactionSupport(ta, Cn) {

      , sa = findFeature(ta, "SendTransaction")
      , oa = {

        extraCurrencyRequired: Cn.requireExtraCurrencies
    };

        throw new WalletNotSupportFeatureError("Wallet doesn't support SendTransaction feature.",{
            cause: {
                requiredFeature: {
                    featureName: "SendTransaction",
                    value: oa
                }
            }
        });
    if (Cn.requireExtraCurrencies && (!sa || !sa.extraCurrencySupported))
        throw new WalletNotSupportFeatureError("Wallet is not able to handle such SendTransaction request. Extra currencies support is required.",{
            cause: {
                requiredFeature: {
                    featureName: "SendTransaction",
                    value: oa
                }
            }
        });
    if (sa && sa.maxMessages !== void 0) {
        if (sa.maxMessages < Cn.requiredMessagesNumber)
            throw new WalletNotSupportFeatureError(`Wallet is not able to handle such SendTransaction request. Max support messages number is ${sa.maxMessages}, but ${Cn.requiredMessagesNumber} is required.`,{
                cause: {
                    requiredFeature: {
                        featureName: "SendTransaction",
                        value: oa
                    }
                }
            });
        return
    }
    logWarning$1("Connected wallet didn't provide information about max allowed messages in the SendTransaction request. Request may be rejected by the wallet.")
}
function checkSignDataSupport(ta, Cn) {

                }

        });
    const sa = Cn.requiredTypes.filter(oa => !na.types.includes(oa));

                requiredFeature: {
                    featureName: "SignData",
                    value: {
                        types: sa
                    }
                }
            }
        })
}

function parseHexAddress(ta) {

        throw new WrongAddressError(`Wrong address ${ta}. Address must include ":".`);
    const Cn = ta.split(":");

        throw new WrongAddressError(`Wrong address ${ta}. Address must include ":" only once.`);
    const na = parseInt(Cn[0]);

        throw new WrongAddressError(`Wrong address ${ta}. WC must be eq 0 or -1, but ${na} received.`);
    const sa = Cn[1];
    if ((sa == null ? void 0 : sa.length) !== 64)
        throw new WrongAddressError(`Wrong address ${ta}. Hex part must be 64bytes length, but ${sa == null ? void 0 : sa.length} received.`);
    return {
        wc: na,
        hex: hexToBytes(sa)
    }
}
function crc16$1(ta) {

}

function getVelocity(ta, Cn) {

        return {
            x: 0,
            y: 0
        };

      , sa = null;
    const oa = lastDevicePoint(ta);
    for (; na >= 0 && (sa = ta[na],
    !(oa.timestamp - sa.timestamp > secondsToMilliseconds(Cn))); )

            y: 0
        };

    if (la === 0)

            x: 0,
            y: 0
        };

        x: (oa.x - sa.x) / la,
        y: (oa.y - sa.y) / la

    Sa.y === 1 / 0 && (Sa.y = 0),

function notifyLayoutUpdate(ta) {
    var na;
    const Cn = ((na = ta.resumeFrom) == null ? void 0 : na.snapshot) || ta.snapshot;
    if (ta.isLead() && ta.layout && Cn && ta.hasListeners("didUpdate")) {

          , {animationType: la} = ta.options
          , Sa = Cn.source !== ta.layout.source;
        la === "size" ? eachAxis(Da => {
            const Ka = Sa ? Cn.measuredBox[Da] : Cn.layoutBox[Da]
              , za = calcLength(Ka);
            Ka.min = sa[Da].min,
            Ka.max = Ka.min + za
        }
        ) : shouldAnimatePositionOnly(la, Cn.layoutBox, sa) && eachAxis(Da => {
            const Ka = Sa ? Cn.measuredBox[Da] : Cn.layoutBox[Da]
              , za = calcLength(sa[Da]);
            Ka.max = Ka.min + za,
            ta.relativeTarget && !ta.currentAnimation && (ta.isProjectionDirty = !0,
            ta.relativeTarget[Da].max = ta.relativeTarget[Da].min + za)
        }
        );
        const wa = createDelta();
        calcBoxDelta(wa, sa, Cn.layoutBox);
        const ja = createDelta();
        Sa ? calcBoxDelta(ja, ta.applyTransform(oa, !0), Cn.measuredBox) : calcBoxDelta(ja, sa, Cn.layoutBox);
        const Na = !isDeltaZero(wa);
        let Fa = !1;
        if (!ta.resumeFrom) {
            const Da = ta.getClosestProjectingParent();
            if (Da && !Da.resumeFrom) {
                const {snapshot: Ka, layout: za} = Da;
                if (Ka && za) {
                    const Ha = createBox();
                    calcRelativePosition(Ha, Cn.layoutBox, Ka.layoutBox);
                    const Qa = createBox();
                    calcRelativePosition(Qa, sa, za.layoutBox),
                    boxEqualsRounded(Ha, Qa) || (Fa = !0),
                    Da.options.layoutRoot && (ta.relativeTarget = Qa,
                    ta.relativeTargetOrigin = Ha,
                    ta.relativeParent = Da)
                }
            }
        }
        ta.notifyListeners("didUpdate", {
            layout: sa,
            snapshot: Cn,
            delta: ja,
            layoutDelta: wa,
            hasLayoutChanged: Na,
            hasRelativeLayoutChanged: Fa
        })
    } else if (ta.isLead()) {

    }
    ta.options.transition = void 0
}

class PluralResolver {
    constructor(Cn, na={}) {
        this.languageUtils = Cn,

    }

    }

    }
    getRule(Cn, na={}) {

          , oa = na.ordinal ? "ordinal" : "cardinal"
          , la = JSON.stringify({
            cleanedCode: sa,
            type: oa
        });

            return this.pluralRulesCache[la];

            Sa = new Intl.PluralRules(sa,{
                type: oa
            })
        } catch {

                dummyRule;
            if (!Cn.match(/-|_/))
                return dummyRule;
            const ja = this.languageUtils.getLanguagePartFromCode(Cn);
            Sa = this.getRule(ja, na)
        }

        Sa
    }
    needsPlural(Cn, na={}) {

        return sa || (sa = this.getRule("dev", na)),
        (sa == null ? void 0 : sa.resolvedOptions().pluralCategories.length) > 1
    }
    getPluralFormsOfKey(Cn, na, sa={}) {
        return this.getSuffixes(Cn, sa).map(oa => `${na}${oa}`)
    }
    getSuffixes(Cn, na={}) {
        let sa = this.getRule(Cn, na);
        return sa || (sa = this.getRule("dev", na)),
        sa ? sa.resolvedOptions().pluralCategories.sort( (oa, la) => suffixesOrder[oa] - suffixesOrder[la]).map(oa => `${this.options.prepend}${na.ordinal ? `ordinal${this.options.prepend}` : ""}${oa}`) : []
    }
    getSuffix(Cn, na, sa={}) {
        const oa = this.getRule(Cn, sa);
        return oa ? `${this.options.prepend}${sa.ordinal ? `ordinal${this.options.prepend}` : ""}${oa.select(na)}` : (this.logger.warn(`no plural rule found for: ${Cn}`),
        this.getSuffix("dev", na, sa))
    }
}

class Formatter {
    constructor(Cn={}) {

    init(Cn, na={

                    ...la

            }

                    ...la,
                    style: "currency"
                });

            }

    add(Cn, na) {

    }
    addCached(Cn, na) {

    }
    format(Cn, na, sa, oa={}) {
        const la = na.split(this.formatSeparator);
        if (la.length > 1 && la[0].indexOf("(") > 1 && la[0].indexOf(")") < 0 && la.find(wa => wa.indexOf(")") > -1)) {

        }

            }
        }),

    }
    setupInterceptors() {

    }
}

class Spring {
    constructor(Cn={}) {
        this.timeStep = .02,
        this.restThreshold = 5e-4,
        this.restDuration = 200,
        this.maxDuration = 6e4,
        this.maxRestSteps = this.restDuration / this.timeStep / K,
        this.maxIterations = this.maxDuration / this.timeStep / K,
        this.m = clamp(setValue(Cn.mass, 1), 0, K),
        this.s = clamp(setValue(Cn.stiffness, 100), 1, K),
        this.d = clamp(setValue(Cn.damping, 10), .1, K),
        this.v = clamp(setValue(Cn.velocity, 0), -1e3, K),
        this.w0 = 0,
        this.zeta = 0,

        this.b = 0,
        this.solverDuration = 0,

        this.compute(),
        this.ease = na => na === 0 || na === 1 ? na : this.solve(na * this.solverDuration)
    }
    solve(Cn) {

        let Sa = Cn;
        return na < 1 ? Sa = exp(-Sa * na * sa) * (1 * cos(oa * Sa) + la * sin(oa * Sa)) : Sa = (1 + la * Sa) * exp(-Sa * sa),
        1 - Sa
    }

            this.solverDuration = Ka,
            Ka += oa,
            Ha++;

    }
    get mass() {
        return this.m
    }
    set mass(Cn) {

        this.compute()
    }
    get stiffness() {
        return this.s
    }
    set stiffness(Cn) {

        this.compute()
    }

    }

                this.eo = PropertyFactory.getProp(ta, Cn.tr.eo, 0, .01, this),
                this.data = Cn,
                this.dynamicProperties.length || this.getValue(!0),
                this._isAnimated = !!this.dynamicProperties.length,
                this.pMatrix = new Matrix,
                this.rMatrix = new Matrix,
                this.sMatrix = new Matrix,
                this.tMatrix = new Matrix,
                this.matrix = new Matrix
            }

            RepeaterModifier.prototype.applyTransforms = function(ta, Cn, na, sa, oa, la) {
                var Sa = la ? -1 : 1
                  , wa = sa.s.v[0] + (1 - sa.s.v[0]) * (1 - oa)
                  , ja = sa.s.v[1] + (1 - sa.s.v[1]) * (1 - oa);
                ta.translate(sa.p.v[0] * Sa * oa, sa.p.v[1] * Sa * oa, sa.p.v[2]),
                Cn.translate(-sa.a.v[0], -sa.a.v[1], sa.a.v[2]),
                Cn.rotate(-sa.r.v * Sa * oa),
                Cn.translate(sa.a.v[0], sa.a.v[1], sa.a.v[2]),
                na.translate(-sa.a.v[0], -sa.a.v[1], sa.a.v[2]),
                na.scale(la ? 1 / wa : wa, la ? 1 / ja : ja),
                na.translate(sa.a.v[0], sa.a.v[1], sa.a.v[2])
            }

            RepeaterModifier.prototype.init = function(ta, Cn, na, sa) {
                for (this.elem = ta,
                this.arr = Cn,
                this.pos = na,
                this.elemsData = sa,
                this._currentCopies = 0,
                this._elements = [],
                this._groups = [],
                this.frameId = -1,
                this.initDynamicPropertyContainer(ta),
                this.initModifierProperties(ta, Cn[na]); na > 0; )
                    na -= 1,
                    this._elements.unshift(Cn[na]);
                this.dynamicProperties.length ? this.k = !0 : this.getValue(!0)
            }

            RepeaterModifier.prototype.resetElements = function(ta) {
                var Cn, na = ta.length;
                for (Cn = 0; Cn < na; Cn += 1)
                    ta[Cn]._processed = !1,
                    ta[Cn].ty === "gr" && this.resetElements(ta[Cn].it)
            }

                var Cn = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(ta));

                Cn

            RepeaterModifier.prototype.processShapes = function(ta) {
                var Cn, na, sa, oa, la, Sa = !1;
                if (this._mdf || ta) {
                    var wa = Math.ceil(this.c.v);
                    if (this._groups.length < wa) {
                        for (; this._groups.length < wa; ) {

                                it: this.cloneElements(this._elements),

                                        s: 0,

                                        t: 0
                                    }, {

                                        e: 0,
                                        t: 1
                                    }]
                                },
                                s: {
                                    a: 0,
                                    ix: 3,
                                    k: [100, 100]
                                },
                                sa: {

                                    ix: 5,
                                    k: 0
                                },
                                sk: {
                                    a: 0,
                                    ix: 4,
                                    k: 0
                                },
                                ty: "tr"
                            }),
                            this.arr.splice(0, 0, ja),
                            this._groups.splice(0, 0, ja),
                            this._currentCopies += 1
                        }
                        this.elem.reloadShapes(),
                        Sa = !0
                    }
                    la = 0;
                    var Na;
                    for (sa = 0; sa <= this._groups.length - 1; sa += 1) {
                        if (Na = la < wa,
                        this._groups[sa]._render = Na,
                        this.changeGroupRender(this._groups[sa].it, Na),
                        !Na) {
                            var Fa = this.elemsData[sa].it
                              , Da = Fa[Fa.length - 1];
                            Da.transform.op.v !== 0 ? (Da.transform.op._mdf = !0,
                            Da.transform.op.v = 0) : Da.transform.op._mdf = !1
                        }
                        la += 1
                    }
                    this._currentCopies = wa;
                    var Ka = this.o.v
                      , za = Ka % 1
                      , Ha = Ka > 0 ? Math.floor(Ka) : Math.ceil(Ka)
                      , Qa = this.pMatrix.props
                      , Wo = this.rMatrix.props
                      , $a = this.sMatrix.props;
                    this.pMatrix.reset(),
                    this.rMatrix.reset(),
                    this.sMatrix.reset(),
                    this.tMatrix.reset(),
                    this.matrix.reset();
                    var Ao = 0;
                    if (Ka > 0) {
                        for (; Ao < Ha; )
                            this.applyTransforms(this.pMatrix, this.rMatrix, this.sMatrix, this.tr, 1, !1),
                            Ao += 1;
                        za && (this.applyTransforms(this.pMatrix, this.rMatrix, this.sMatrix, this.tr, za, !1),
                        Ao += za)
                    } else if (Ka < 0) {
                        for (; Ao > Ha; )
                            this.applyTransforms(this.pMatrix, this.rMatrix, this.sMatrix, this.tr, 1, !0),
                            Ao -= 1;
                        za && (this.applyTransforms(this.pMatrix, this.rMatrix, this.sMatrix, this.tr, -za, !0),
                        Ao -= za)
                    }
                    sa = this.data.m === 1 ? 0 : this._currentCopies - 1,
                    oa = this.data.m === 1 ? 1 : -1,
                    la = this._currentCopies;
                    for (var Mo, Qo; la; ) {
                        if (Cn = this.elemsData[sa].it,
                        na = Cn[Cn.length - 1].transform.mProps.v.props,
                        Qo = na.length,
                        Cn[Cn.length - 1].transform.mProps._mdf = !0,
                        Cn[Cn.length - 1].transform.op._mdf = !0,
                        Cn[Cn.length - 1].transform.op.v = this._currentCopies === 1 ? this.so.v : this.so.v + (this.eo.v - this.so.v) * (sa / (this._currentCopies - 1)),
                        Ao !== 0) {
                            for ((sa !== 0 && oa === 1 || sa !== this._currentCopies - 1 && oa === -1) && this.applyTransforms(this.pMatrix, this.rMatrix, this.sMatrix, this.tr, 1, !1),
                            this.matrix.transform(Wo[0], Wo[1], Wo[2], Wo[3], Wo[4], Wo[5], Wo[6], Wo[7], Wo[8], Wo[9], Wo[10], Wo[11], Wo[12], Wo[13], Wo[14], Wo[15]),
                            this.matrix.transform($a[0], $a[1], $a[2], $a[3], $a[4], $a[5], $a[6], $a[7], $a[8], $a[9], $a[10], $a[11], $a[12], $a[13], $a[14], $a[15]),
                            this.matrix.transform(Qa[0], Qa[1], Qa[2], Qa[3], Qa[4], Qa[5], Qa[6], Qa[7], Qa[8], Qa[9], Qa[10], Qa[11], Qa[12], Qa[13], Qa[14], Qa[15]),
                            Mo = 0; Mo < Qo; Mo += 1)
                                na[Mo] = this.matrix.props[Mo];
                            this.matrix.reset()
                        } else
                            for (this.matrix.reset(),
                            Mo = 0; Mo < Qo; Mo += 1)
                                na[Mo] = this.matrix.props[Mo];
                        Ao += 1,
                        la -= 1,
                        sa += oa
                    }
                } else
                    for (la = this._currentCopies,
                    sa = 0,
                    oa = 1; la; )
                        Cn = this.elemsData[sa].it,
                        na = Cn[Cn.length - 1].transform.mProps.v.props,
                        Cn[Cn.length - 1].transform.mProps._mdf = !1,
                        Cn[Cn.length - 1].transform.op._mdf = !1,
                        la -= 1,
                        sa += oa;
                return Sa
            }

            function RoundCornersModifier() {}
            extendPrototype([ShapeModifier], RoundCornersModifier),
            RoundCornersModifier.prototype.initModifierProperties = function(ta, Cn) {
                this.getValue = this.processKeys,
                this.rd = PropertyFactory.getProp(ta, Cn.r, 0, null, this),
                this._isAnimated = !!this.rd.effectsSequence.length
            }
            ,
            RoundCornersModifier.prototype.processPath = function(ta, Cn) {
                var na = shapePool.newElement();
                na.c = ta.c;
                var sa, oa = ta._length, la, Sa, wa, ja, Na, Fa, Da = 0, Ka, za, Ha, Qa, Wo, $a;
                for (sa = 0; sa < oa; sa += 1)
                    la = ta.v[sa],
                    wa = ta.o[sa],
                    Sa = ta.i[sa],
                    la[0] === wa[0] && la[1] === wa[1] && la[0] === Sa[0] && la[1] === Sa[1] ? (sa === 0 || sa === oa - 1) && !ta.c ? (na.setTripleAt(la[0], la[1], wa[0], wa[1], Sa[0], Sa[1], Da),
                    Da += 1) : (sa === 0 ? ja = ta.v[oa - 1] : ja = ta.v[sa - 1],
                    Na = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(la[0] - ja[0], 2) + Math.pow(la[1] - ja[1], 2)),
                    Fa = Na ? Math.min(Na / 2, Cn) / Na : 0,
                    Wo = la[0] + (ja[0] - la[0]) * Fa,
                    Ka = Wo,
                    $a = la[1] - (la[1] - ja[1]) * Fa,
                    za = $a,
                    Ha = Ka - (Ka - la[0]) * roundCorner,
                    Qa = za - (za - la[1]) * roundCorner,
                    na.setTripleAt(Ka, za, Ha, Qa, Wo, $a, Da),
                    Da += 1,
                    sa === oa - 1 ? ja = ta.v[0] : ja = ta.v[sa + 1],
                    Na = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(la[0] - ja[0], 2) + Math.pow(la[1] - ja[1], 2)),
                    Fa = Na ? Math.min(Na / 2, Cn) / Na : 0,
                    Ha = la[0] + (ja[0] - la[0]) * Fa,
                    Ka = Ha,
                    Qa = la[1] + (ja[1] - la[1]) * Fa,
                    za = Qa,
                    Wo = Ka - (Ka - la[0]) * roundCorner,
                    $a = za - (za - la[1]) * roundCorner,
                    na.setTripleAt(Ka, za, Ha, Qa, Wo, $a, Da),
                    Da += 1) : (na.setTripleAt(ta.v[sa][0], ta.v[sa][1], ta.o[sa][0], ta.o[sa][1], ta.i[sa][0], ta.i[sa][1], Da),
                    Da += 1);
                return na
            }
            ,
            RoundCornersModifier.prototype.processShapes = function(ta) {
                var Cn, na, sa = this.shapes.length, oa, la, Sa = this.rd.v;
                if (Sa !== 0) {
                    var wa, ja;
                    for (na = 0; na < sa; na += 1) {
                        if (wa = this.shapes[na],
                        ja = wa.localShapeCollection,
                        !(!wa.shape._mdf && !this._mdf && !ta))
                            for (ja.releaseShapes(),
                            wa.shape._mdf = !0,
                            Cn = wa.shape.paths.shapes,
                            la = wa.shape.paths._length,
                            oa = 0; oa < la; oa += 1)
                                ja.addShape(this.processPath(Cn[oa], Sa));
                        wa.shape.paths = wa.localShapeCollection
                    }
                }
                this.dynamicProperties.length || (this._mdf = !1)
            }
            ;
            function floatEqual(ta, Cn) {
                return Math.abs(ta - Cn) * 1e5 <= Math.min(Math.abs(ta), Math.abs(Cn))
            }
            function floatZero(ta) {
                return Math.abs(ta) <= 1e-5
            }
            function lerp(ta, Cn, na) {
                return ta * (1 - na) + Cn * na
            }
            function lerpPoint(ta, Cn, na) {
                return [lerp(ta[0], Cn[0], na), lerp(ta[1], Cn[1], na)]
            }
            function quadRoots(ta, Cn, na) {
                if (ta === 0)
                    return [];
                var sa = Cn * Cn - 4 * ta * na;
                if (sa < 0)
                    return [];
                var oa = -Cn / (2 * ta);
                if (sa === 0)
                    return [oa];
                var la = Math.sqrt(sa) / (2 * ta);
                return [oa - la, oa + la]
            }
            function polynomialCoefficients(ta, Cn, na, sa) {
                return [-ta + 3 * Cn - 3 * na + sa, 3 * ta - 6 * Cn + 3 * na, -3 * ta + 3 * Cn, ta]
            }
            function singlePoint(ta) {
                return new PolynomialBezier(ta,ta,ta,ta,!1)
            }
            function PolynomialBezier(ta, Cn, na, sa, oa) {
                oa && pointEqual(ta, Cn) && (Cn = lerpPoint(ta, sa, 1 / 3)),
                oa && pointEqual(na, sa) && (na = lerpPoint(ta, sa, 2 / 3));
                var la = polynomialCoefficients(ta[0], Cn[0], na[0], sa[0])
                  , Sa = polynomialCoefficients(ta[1], Cn[1], na[1], sa[1]);
                this.a = [la[0], Sa[0]],
                this.b = [la[1], Sa[1]],
                this.c = [la[2], Sa[2]],
                this.d = [la[3], Sa[3]],
                this.points = [ta, Cn, na, sa]
            }
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.point = function(ta) {
                return [((this.a[0] * ta + this.b[0]) * ta + this.c[0]) * ta + this.d[0], ((this.a[1] * ta + this.b[1]) * ta + this.c[1]) * ta + this.d[1]]
            }
            ,
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.derivative = function(ta) {
                return [(3 * ta * this.a[0] + 2 * this.b[0]) * ta + this.c[0], (3 * ta * this.a[1] + 2 * this.b[1]) * ta + this.c[1]]
            }
            ,
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.tangentAngle = function(ta) {
                var Cn = this.derivative(ta);
                return Math.atan2(Cn[1], Cn[0])
            }
            ,
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.normalAngle = function(ta) {
                var Cn = this.derivative(ta);
                return Math.atan2(Cn[0], Cn[1])
            }
            ,
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.inflectionPoints = function() {
                var ta = this.a[1] * this.b[0] - this.a[0] * this.b[1];
                if (floatZero(ta))
                    return [];
                var Cn = -.5 * (this.a[1] * this.c[0] - this.a[0] * this.c[1]) / ta
                  , na = Cn * Cn - 1 / 3 * (this.b[1] * this.c[0] - this.b[0] * this.c[1]) / ta;
                if (na < 0)
                    return [];
                var sa = Math.sqrt(na);
                return floatZero(sa) ? sa > 0 && sa < 1 ? [Cn] : [] : [Cn - sa, Cn + sa].filter(function(oa) {
                    return oa > 0 && oa < 1
                })
            }
            ,
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.split = function(ta) {
                if (ta <= 0)
                    return [singlePoint(this.points[0]), this];
                if (ta >= 1)
                    return [this, singlePoint(this.points[this.points.length - 1])];
                var Cn = lerpPoint(this.points[0], this.points[1], ta)
                  , na = lerpPoint(this.points[1], this.points[2], ta)
                  , sa = lerpPoint(this.points[2], this.points[3], ta)
                  , oa = lerpPoint(Cn, na, ta)
                  , la = lerpPoint(na, sa, ta)
                  , Sa = lerpPoint(oa, la, ta);
                return [new PolynomialBezier(this.points[0],Cn,oa,Sa,!0), new PolynomialBezier(Sa,la,sa,this.points[3],!0)]
            }
            ;
            function extrema(ta, Cn) {
                var na = ta.points[0][Cn]
                  , sa = ta.points[ta.points.length - 1][Cn];
                if (na > sa) {
                    var oa = sa;
                    sa = na,
                    na = oa
                }
                for (var la = quadRoots(3 * ta.a[Cn], 2 * ta.b[Cn], ta.c[Cn]), Sa = 0; Sa < la.length; Sa += 1)
                    if (la[Sa] > 0 && la[Sa] < 1) {
                        var wa = ta.point(la[Sa])[Cn];
                        wa < na ? na = wa : wa > sa && (sa = wa)
                    }
                return {
                    min: na,
                    max: sa
                }
            }
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.bounds = function() {
                return {
                    x: extrema(this, 0),
                    y: extrema(this, 1)
                }
            }
            ,
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.boundingBox = function() {
                var ta = this.bounds();
                return {
                    left: ta.x.min,
                    right: ta.x.max,
                    top: ta.y.min,
                    bottom: ta.y.max,
                    width: ta.x.max - ta.x.min,
                    height: ta.y.max - ta.y.min,
                    cx: (ta.x.max + ta.x.min) / 2,
                    cy: (ta.y.max + ta.y.min) / 2
                }
            }
            ;
            function intersectData(ta, Cn, na) {
                var sa = ta.boundingBox();
                return {
                    cx: sa.cx,
                    cy: sa.cy,
                    width: sa.width,
                    height: sa.height,
                    bez: ta,
                    t: (Cn + na) / 2,
                    t1: Cn,
                    t2: na
                }
            }
            function splitData(ta) {
                var Cn = ta.bez.split(.5);
                return [intersectData(Cn[0], ta.t1, ta.t), intersectData(Cn[1], ta.t, ta.t2)]
            }
            function boxIntersect(ta, Cn) {
                return Math.abs(ta.cx - Cn.cx) * 2 < ta.width + Cn.width && Math.abs(ta.cy - Cn.cy) * 2 < ta.height + Cn.height
            }
            function intersectsImpl(ta, Cn, na, sa, oa, la) {
                if (boxIntersect(ta, Cn)) {
                    if (na >= la || ta.width <= sa && ta.height <= sa && Cn.width <= sa && Cn.height <= sa) {
                        oa.push([ta.t, Cn.t]);
                        return
                    }
                    var Sa = splitData(ta)
                      , wa = splitData(Cn);
                    intersectsImpl(Sa[0], wa[0], na + 1, sa, oa, la),
                    intersectsImpl(Sa[0], wa[1], na + 1, sa, oa, la),
                    intersectsImpl(Sa[1], wa[0], na + 1, sa, oa, la),
                    intersectsImpl(Sa[1], wa[1], na + 1, sa, oa, la)
                }
            }
            PolynomialBezier.prototype.intersections = function(ta, Cn, na) {
                Cn === void 0 && (Cn = 2),
                na === void 0 && (na = 7);
                var sa = [];
                return intersectsImpl(intersectData(this, 0, 1), intersectData(ta, 0, 1), 0, Cn, sa, na),
                sa
            }
            ,
            PolynomialBezier.shapeSegment = function(ta, Cn) {
                var na = (Cn + 1) % ta.length();
                return new PolynomialBezier(ta.v[Cn],ta.o[Cn],ta.i[na],ta.v[na],!0)
            }
            ,
            PolynomialBezier.shapeSegmentInverted = function(ta, Cn) {
                var na = (Cn + 1) % ta.length();
                return new PolynomialBezier(ta.v[na],ta.i[na],ta.o[Cn],ta.v[Cn],!0)
            }
            ;
            function crossProduct(ta, Cn) {
                return [ta[1] * Cn[2] - ta[2] * Cn[1], ta[2] * Cn[0] - ta[0] * Cn[2], ta[0] * Cn[1] - ta[1] * Cn[0]]
            }
            function lineIntersection(ta, Cn, na, sa) {
                var oa = [ta[0], ta[1], 1]
                  , la = [Cn[0], Cn[1], 1]
                  , Sa = [na[0], na[1], 1]
                  , wa = [sa[0], sa[1], 1]
                  , ja = crossProduct(crossProduct(oa, la), crossProduct(Sa, wa));
                return floatZero(ja[2]) ? null : [ja[0] / ja[2], ja[1] / ja[2]]
            }
            function polarOffset(ta, Cn, na) {
                return [ta[0] + Math.cos(Cn) * na, ta[1] - Math.sin(Cn) * na]
            }
            function pointDistance(ta, Cn) {
                return Math.hypot(ta[0] - Cn[0], ta[1] - Cn[1])
            }
            function pointEqual(ta, Cn) {
                return floatEqual(ta[0], Cn[0]) && floatEqual(ta[1], Cn[1])
            }
            function ZigZagModifier() {}
            extendPrototype([ShapeModifier], ZigZagModifier),
            ZigZagModifier.prototype.initModifierProperties = function(ta, Cn) {
                this.getValue = this.processKeys,
                this.amplitude = PropertyFactory.getProp(ta, Cn.s, 0, null, this),
                this.frequency = PropertyFactory.getProp(ta, Cn.r, 0, null, this),
                this.pointsType = PropertyFactory.getProp(ta, Cn.pt, 0, null, this),
                this._isAnimated = this.amplitude.effectsSequence.length !== 0 || this.frequency.effectsSequence.length !== 0 || this.pointsType.effectsSequence.length !== 0
            }
            ;
            function setPoint(ta, Cn, na, sa, oa, la, Sa) {
                var wa = na - Math.PI / 2
                  , ja = na + Math.PI / 2
                  , Na = Cn[0] + Math.cos(na) * sa * oa
                  , Fa = Cn[1] - Math.sin(na) * sa * oa;
                ta.setTripleAt(Na, Fa, Na + Math.cos(wa) * la, Fa - Math.sin(wa) * la, Na + Math.cos(ja) * Sa, Fa - Math.sin(ja) * Sa, ta.length())
            }
            function getPerpendicularVector(ta, Cn) {
                var na = [Cn[0] - ta[0], Cn[1] - ta[1]]
                  , sa = -Math.PI * .5
                  , oa = [Math.cos(sa) * na[0] - Math.sin(sa) * na[1], Math.sin(sa) * na[0] + Math.cos(sa) * na[1]];
                return oa
            }
            function getProjectingAngle(ta, Cn) {
                var na = Cn === 0 ? ta.length() - 1 : Cn - 1
                  , sa = (Cn + 1) % ta.length()
                  , oa = ta.v[na]
                  , la = ta.v[sa]
                  , Sa = getPerpendicularVector(oa, la);
                return Math.atan2(0, 1) - Math.atan2(Sa[1], Sa[0])
            }
            function zigZagCorner(ta, Cn, na, sa, oa, la, Sa) {
                var wa = getProjectingAngle(Cn, na)
                  , ja = Cn.v[na % Cn._length]
                  , Na = Cn.v[na === 0 ? Cn._length - 1 : na - 1]
                  , Fa = Cn.v[(na + 1) % Cn._length]
                  , Da = la === 2 ? Math.sqrt(Math.pow(ja[0] - Na[0], 2) + Math.pow(ja[1] - Na[1], 2)) : 0
                  , Ka = la === 2 ? Math.sqrt(Math.pow(ja[0] - Fa[0], 2) + Math.pow(ja[1] - Fa[1], 2)) : 0;
                setPoint(ta, Cn.v[na % Cn._length], wa, Sa, sa, Ka / ((oa + 1) * 2), Da / ((oa + 1) * 2))
            }
            function zigZagSegment(ta, Cn, na, sa, oa, la) {
                for (var Sa = 0; Sa < sa; Sa += 1) {
                    var wa = (Sa + 1) / (sa + 1)
                      , ja = oa === 2 ? Math.sqrt(Math.pow(Cn.points[3][0] - Cn.points[0][0], 2) + Math.pow(Cn.points[3][1] - Cn.points[0][1], 2)) : 0
                      , Na = Cn.normalAngle(wa)
                      , Fa = Cn.point(wa);

            function TransformElement() {}
            TransformElement.prototype = {
                initTransform: function() {
                    var Cn = new Matrix;
                    this.finalTransform = {
                        mProp: this.data.ks ? TransformPropertyFactory.getTransformProperty(this, this.data.ks, this) : {
                            o: 0
                        },
                        _matMdf: !1,
                        _localMatMdf: !1,
                        _opMdf: !1,
                        mat: Cn,
                        localMat: Cn,
                        localOpacity: 1
                    },
                    this.data.ao && (this.finalTransform.mProp.autoOriented = !0),
                    this.data.ty
                },
                renderTransform: function() {
                    if (this.finalTransform._opMdf = this.finalTransform.mProp.o._mdf || this._isFirstFrame,
                    this.finalTransform._matMdf = this.finalTransform.mProp._mdf || this._isFirstFrame,
                    this.hierarchy) {
                        var Cn, na = this.finalTransform.mat, sa = 0, oa = this.hierarchy.length;
                        if (!this.finalTransform._matMdf)
                            for (; sa < oa; ) {
                                if (this.hierarchy[sa].finalTransform.mProp._mdf) {
                                    this.finalTransform._matMdf = !0;
                                    break
                                }
                                sa += 1
                            }
                        if (this.finalTransform._matMdf)
                            for (Cn = this.finalTransform.mProp.v.props,
                            na.cloneFromProps(Cn),
                            sa = 0; sa < oa; sa += 1)
                                na.multiply(this.hierarchy[sa].finalTransform.mProp.v)
                    }
                    (!this.localTransforms || this.finalTransform._matMdf) && (this.finalTransform._localMatMdf = this.finalTransform._matMdf),
                    this.finalTransform._opMdf && (this.finalTransform.localOpacity = this.finalTransform.mProp.o.v)
                },
                renderLocalTransform: function() {
                    if (this.localTransforms) {
                        var Cn = 0
                          , na = this.localTransforms.length;
                        if (this.finalTransform._localMatMdf = this.finalTransform._matMdf,
                        !this.finalTransform._localMatMdf || !this.finalTransform._opMdf)
                            for (; Cn < na; )
                                this.localTransforms[Cn]._mdf && (this.finalTransform._localMatMdf = !0),
                                this.localTransforms[Cn]._opMdf && !this.finalTransform._opMdf && (this.finalTransform.localOpacity = this.finalTransform.mProp.o.v,
                                this.finalTransform._opMdf = !0),
                                Cn += 1;
                        if (this.finalTransform._localMatMdf) {
                            var sa = this.finalTransform.localMat;
                            for (this.localTransforms[0].matrix.clone(sa),
                            Cn = 1; Cn < na; Cn += 1) {
                                var oa = this.localTransforms[Cn].matrix;
                                sa.multiply(oa)
                            }
                            sa.multiply(this.finalTransform.mat)
                        }
                        if (this.finalTransform._opMdf) {
                            var la = this.finalTransform.localOpacity;
                            for (Cn = 0; Cn < na; Cn += 1)
                                la *= this.localTransforms[Cn].opacity * .01;
                            this.finalTransform.localOpacity = la
                        }
                    }
                },
                searchEffectTransforms: function() {
                    if (this.renderableEffectsManager) {
                        var Cn = this.renderableEffectsManager.getEffects(effectTypes.TRANSFORM_EFFECT);
                        if (Cn.length) {
                            this.localTransforms = [],
                            this.finalTransform.localMat = new Matrix;
                            var na = 0
                              , sa = Cn.length;
                            for (na = 0; na < sa; na += 1)
                                this.localTransforms.push(Cn[na])
                        }
                    }
                },
                globalToLocal: function(Cn) {
                    var na = [];
                    na.push(this.finalTransform);
                    for (var sa = !0, oa = this.comp; sa; )
                        oa.finalTransform ? (oa.data.hasMask && na.splice(0, 0, oa.finalTransform),
                        oa = oa.comp) : sa = !1;
                    var la, Sa = na.length, wa;
                    for (la = 0; la < Sa; la += 1)
                        wa = na[la].mat.applyToPointArray(0, 0, 0),
                        Cn = [Cn[0] - wa[0], Cn[1] - wa[1], 0];
                    return Cn
                },
                mHelper: new Matrix
            };

            MaskElement.prototype.getMaskProperty = function(ta) {

            MaskElement.prototype.renderFrame = function(ta) {

                for (na = 0; na < sa; na += 1)
                    if ((this.viewData[na].prop._mdf || ta) && this.drawPath(this.masksProperties[na], this.viewData[na].prop.v, this.viewData[na]),
                    (this.viewData[na].op._mdf || ta) && this.viewData[na].elem.setAttribute("fill-opacity", this.viewData[na].op.v),

            function ShapeTransformManager() {

            ShapeTransformManager.prototype = {
                addTransformSequence: function(Cn) {
                    var na, sa = Cn.length, oa = "_";
                    for (na = 0; na < sa; na += 1)
                        oa += Cn[na].transform.key + "_";
                    var la = this.sequences[oa];
                    return la || (la = {
                        transforms: [].concat(Cn),
                        finalTransform: new Matrix,
                        _mdf: !1
                    },
                    this.sequences[oa] = la,
                    this.sequenceList.push(la)),
                    la
                },
                processSequence: function(Cn, na) {
                    for (var sa = 0, oa = Cn.transforms.length, la = na; sa < oa && !na; ) {
                        if (Cn.transforms[sa].transform.mProps._mdf) {
                            la = !0;
                            break
                        }
                        sa += 1
                    }
                    if (la)
                        for (Cn.finalTransform.reset(),
                        sa = oa - 1; sa >= 0; sa -= 1)
                            Cn.finalTransform.multiply(Cn.transforms[sa].transform.mProps.v);
                    Cn._mdf = la
                },
                processSequences: function(Cn) {
                    var na, sa = this.sequenceList.length;
                    for (na = 0; na < sa; na += 1)
                        this.processSequence(this.sequenceList[na], Cn)
                },
                getNewKey: function() {
                    return this.transform_key_count += 1,
                    "_" + this.transform_key_count
                }
            };

            CVMaskElement.prototype.renderFrame = function() {
                if (this.hasMasks) {
                    var ta = this.element.finalTransform.mat, Cn = this.element.canvasContext, na, sa = this.masksProperties.length, oa, la, Sa;
                    for (Cn.beginPath(),
                    na = 0; na < sa; na += 1)

                            this.masksProperties[na].inv && (Cn.moveTo(0, 0),
                            Cn.lineTo(this.element.globalData.compSize.w, 0),

            CVShapeElement.prototype.createStyleElement = function(ta, Cn) {

                    type: ta.ty,
                    preTransforms: this.transformsManager.addTransformSequence(Cn),
                    transforms: [],
                    elements: [],

                  , sa = {};

                sa.c.k || (na.co = "rgb(" + bmFloor(sa.c.v[0]) + "," + bmFloor(sa.c.v[1]) + "," + bmFloor(sa.c.v[2]) + ")")) : (ta.ty === "gf" || ta.ty === "gs") && (sa.s = PropertyFactory.getProp(this, ta.s, 1, null, this),

                    na.lj = lineJoinEnum[ta.lj || 2],

                        na.do = sa.d.dashoffset[0])
                    }
                } else
                    na.r = ta.r === 2 ? "evenodd" : "nonzero";
                return this.stylesList.push(na),
                sa.style = na,
                sa
            }

            CVShapeElement.prototype.searchShapes = function(ta, Cn, na, sa, oa) {

                for (la = Sa; la >= 0; la -= 1) {
                    if (Da = this.searchProcessedElement(ta[la]),
                    Da ? Cn[la] = na[Da - 1] : ta[la]._shouldRender = sa,
                    ta[la].ty === "fl" || ta[la].ty === "st" || ta[la].ty === "gf" || ta[la].ty === "gs")
                        Da ? Cn[la].style.closed = !1 : Cn[la] = this.createStyleElement(ta[la], Ha),
                        Na.push(Cn[la].style);
                    else if (ta[la].ty === "gr") {
                        if (!Da)
                            Cn[la] = this.createGroupElement(ta[la]);
                        else
                            for (ja = Cn[la].it.length,
                            wa = 0; wa < ja; wa += 1)
                                Cn[la].prevViewData[wa] = Cn[la].it[wa];
                        this.searchShapes(ta[la].it, Cn[la].it, Cn[la].prevViewData, sa, Ha)
                    } else
                        ta[la].ty === "tr" ? (Da || (za = this.createTransformElement(ta[la]),
                        Cn[la] = za),
                        Ha.push(Cn[la]),
                        this.addTransformToStyleList(Cn[la])) : ta[la].ty === "sh" || ta[la].ty === "rc" || ta[la].ty === "el" || ta[la].ty === "sr" ? Da || (Cn[la] = this.createShapeElement(ta[la])) : ta[la].ty === "tm" || ta[la].ty === "rd" || ta[la].ty === "pb" || ta[la].ty === "zz" || ta[la].ty === "op" ? (Da ? (Ka = Cn[la],
                        Ka.closed = !1) : (Ka = ShapeModifiers.getModifier(ta[la].ty),
                        Ka.init(this, ta[la]),
                        Cn[la] = Ka,

                        Ka.closed = !0) : (Ka = ShapeModifiers.getModifier(ta[la].ty),

                        this.shapeModifiers.push(Ka),
                        sa = !1),

                }

            }

            CVShapeElement.prototype.renderShapeTransform = function(ta, Cn) {
                (ta._opMdf || Cn.op._mdf || this._isFirstFrame) && (Cn.opacity = ta.opacity,

            CVShapeElement.prototype.drawLayer = function() {
                var ta, Cn = this.stylesList.length, na, sa, oa, la, Sa, wa, ja = this.globalData.renderer, Na = this.globalData.canvasContext, Fa, Da;
                for (ta = 0; ta < Cn; ta += 1)
                    if (Da = this.stylesList[ta],
                    Fa = Da.type,
                    !((Fa === "st" || Fa === "gs") && Da.wi === 0 || !Da.data._shouldRender || Da.coOp === 0 || this.globalData.currentGlobalAlpha === 0)) {
                        for (ja.save(),
                        Sa = Da.elements,
                        Fa === "st" || Fa === "gs" ? (ja.ctxStrokeStyle(Fa === "st" ? Da.co : Da.grd),
                        ja.ctxLineWidth(Da.wi),
                        ja.ctxLineCap(Da.lc),
                        ja.ctxLineJoin(Da.lj),
                        ja.ctxMiterLimit(Da.ml || 0)) : ja.ctxFillStyle(Fa === "fl" ? Da.co : Da.grd),
                        ja.ctxOpacity(Da.coOp),
                        Fa !== "st" && Fa !== "gs" && Na.beginPath(),
                        ja.ctxTransform(Da.preTransforms.finalTransform.props),
                        sa = Sa.length,
                        na = 0; na < sa; na += 1) {
                            for ((Fa === "st" || Fa === "gs") && (Na.beginPath(),
                            Da.da && (Na.setLineDash(Da.da),
                            Na.lineDashOffset = Da.do)),
                            wa = Sa[na].trNodes,
                            la = wa.length,
                            oa = 0; oa < la; oa += 1)
                                wa[oa].t === "m" ? Na.moveTo(wa[oa].p[0], wa[oa].p[1]) : wa[oa].t === "c" ? Na.bezierCurveTo(wa[oa].pts[0], wa[oa].pts[1], wa[oa].pts[2], wa[oa].pts[3], wa[oa].pts[4], wa[oa].pts[5]) : Na.closePath();
                            (Fa === "st" || Fa === "gs") && (ja.ctxStroke(),
                            Da.da && Na.setLineDash(this.dashResetter))
                        }
                        Fa !== "st" && Fa !== "gs" && this.globalData.renderer.ctxFill(Da.r),
                        ja.restore()
                    }
            }

            CVShapeElement.prototype.renderShape = function(ta, Cn, na, sa) {
                var oa, la = Cn.length - 1, Sa;
                for (Sa = ta,
                oa = la; oa >= 0; oa -= 1)
                    Cn[oa].ty === "tr" ? (Sa = na[oa].transform,
                    this.renderShapeTransform(ta, Sa)) : Cn[oa].ty === "sh" || Cn[oa].ty === "el" || Cn[oa].ty === "rc" || Cn[oa].ty === "sr" ? this.renderPath(Cn[oa], na[oa]) : Cn[oa].ty === "fl" ? this.renderFill(Cn[oa], na[oa], Sa) : Cn[oa].ty === "st" ? this.renderStroke(Cn[oa], na[oa], Sa) : Cn[oa].ty === "gf" || Cn[oa].ty === "gs" ? this.renderGradientFill(Cn[oa], na[oa], Sa) : Cn[oa].ty === "gr" ? this.renderShape(Sa, Cn[oa].it, na[oa].it) : Cn[oa].ty;
                sa && this.drawLayer()
            }

            CVShapeElement.prototype.renderStyledShape = function(ta, Cn) {
                if (this._isFirstFrame || Cn._mdf || ta.transforms._mdf) {

                                oa === 1 && na.push({

                                    p: ja.applyToPointArray(Na.v[0][0], Na.v[0][1], 0)
                                }),
                                na.push({
                                    t: "c",
                                    pts: ja.applyToTriplePoints(Na.o[oa - 1], Na.i[oa], Na.v[oa])
                                });
                            la === 1 && na.push({
                                t: "m",
                                p: ja.applyToPointArray(Na.v[0][0], Na.v[0][1], 0)
                            }),
                            Na.c && la && (na.push({
                                t: "c",
                                pts: ja.applyToTriplePoints(Na.o[oa - 1], Na.i[0], Na.v[0])
                            }),
                            na.push({
                                t: "z"
                            }))
                        }
                    }
                    ta.trNodes = na
                }
            }

            CVShapeElement.prototype.renderGradientFill = function(ta, Cn, na) {
                var sa = Cn.style, oa;
                if (!sa.grd || Cn.g._mdf || Cn.s._mdf || Cn.e._mdf || ta.t !== 1 && (Cn.h._mdf || Cn.a._mdf)) {
                    var la = this.globalData.canvasContext
                      , Sa = Cn.s.v
                      , wa = Cn.e.v;
                    if (ta.t === 1)
                        oa = la.createLinearGradient(Sa[0], Sa[1], wa[0], wa[1]);
                    else {
                        var ja = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(Sa[0] - wa[0], 2) + Math.pow(Sa[1] - wa[1], 2))
                          , Na = Math.atan2(wa[1] - Sa[1], wa[0] - Sa[0])
                          , Fa = Cn.h.v;
                        Fa >= 1 ? Fa = .99 : Fa <= -1 && (Fa = -.99);
                        var Da = ja * Fa
                          , Ka = Math.cos(Na + Cn.a.v) * Da + Sa[0]
                          , za = Math.sin(Na + Cn.a.v) * Da + Sa[1];
                        oa = la.createRadialGradient(Ka, za, 0, Sa[0], Sa[1], ja)
                    }
                    var Ha, Qa = ta.g.p, Wo = Cn.g.c, $a = 1;
                    for (Ha = 0; Ha < Qa; Ha += 1)
                        Cn.g._hasOpacity && Cn.g._collapsable && ($a = Cn.g.o[Ha * 2 + 1]),
                        oa.addColorStop(Wo[Ha * 4] / 100, "rgba(" + Wo[Ha * 4 + 1] + "," + Wo[Ha * 4 + 2] + "," + Wo[Ha * 4 + 3] + "," + $a + ")");
                    sa.grd = oa
                }
                sa.coOp = Cn.o.v * na.opacity
            }

            CanvasRendererBase.prototype.updateContainerSize = function(ta, Cn) {
                this.reset();
                var na, sa;
                ta ? (na = ta,
                sa = Cn,
                this.canvasContext.canvas.width = na,
                this.canvasContext.canvas.height = sa) : (this.animationItem.wrapper && this.animationItem.container ? (na = this.animationItem.wrapper.offsetWidth,

                sa = this.canvasContext.canvas.height),

                this.canvasContext.canvas.height = sa * this.renderConfig.dpr);
                var oa, la;
                if (this.renderConfig.preserveAspectRatio.indexOf("meet") !== -1 || this.renderConfig.preserveAspectRatio.indexOf("slice") !== -1) {
                    var Sa = this.renderConfig.preserveAspectRatio.split(" ")
                      , wa = Sa[1] || "meet"
                      , ja = Sa[0] || "xMidYMid"
                      , Na = ja.substr(0, 4)
                      , Fa = ja.substr(4);
                    oa = na / sa,
                    la = this.transformCanvas.w / this.transformCanvas.h,
                    la > oa && wa === "meet" || la < oa && wa === "slice" ? (this.transformCanvas.sx = na / (this.transformCanvas.w / this.renderConfig.dpr),
                    this.transformCanvas.sy = na / (this.transformCanvas.w / this.renderConfig.dpr)) : (this.transformCanvas.sx = sa / (this.transformCanvas.h / this.renderConfig.dpr),
                    this.transformCanvas.sy = sa / (this.transformCanvas.h / this.renderConfig.dpr)),
                    Na === "xMid" && (la < oa && wa === "meet" || la > oa && wa === "slice") ? this.transformCanvas.tx = (na - this.transformCanvas.w * (sa / this.transformCanvas.h)) / 2 * this.renderConfig.dpr : Na === "xMax" && (la < oa && wa === "meet" || la > oa && wa === "slice") ? this.transformCanvas.tx = (na - this.transformCanvas.w * (sa / this.transformCanvas.h)) * this.renderConfig.dpr : this.transformCanvas.tx = 0,
                    Fa === "YMid" && (la > oa && wa === "meet" || la < oa && wa === "slice") ? this.transformCanvas.ty = (sa - this.transformCanvas.h * (na / this.transformCanvas.w)) / 2 * this.renderConfig.dpr : Fa === "YMax" && (la > oa && wa === "meet" || la < oa && wa === "slice") ? this.transformCanvas.ty = (sa - this.transformCanvas.h * (na / this.transformCanvas.w)) * this.renderConfig.dpr : this.transformCanvas.ty = 0
                } else
                    this.renderConfig.preserveAspectRatio === "none" ? (this.transformCanvas.sx = na / (this.transformCanvas.w / this.renderConfig.dpr),
                    this.transformCanvas.sy = sa / (this.transformCanvas.h / this.renderConfig.dpr),
                    this.transformCanvas.tx = 0,
                    this.transformCanvas.ty = 0) : (this.transformCanvas.sx = this.renderConfig.dpr,
                    this.transformCanvas.sy = this.renderConfig.dpr,
                    this.transformCanvas.tx = 0,
                    this.transformCanvas.ty = 0);

                this.ctxTransform(this.transformCanvas.props),

            function CVContextData() {
                this.stack = [],
                this.cArrPos = 0,
                this.cTr = new Matrix;
                var ta, Cn = 15;
                for (ta = 0; ta < Cn; ta += 1) {
                    var na = new CanvasContext;
                    this.stack[ta] = na
                }
                this._length = Cn,
                this.nativeContext = null,
                this.transformMat = new Matrix,
                this.currentOpacity = 1,
                this.currentFillStyle = "",
                this.appliedFillStyle = "",
                this.currentStrokeStyle = "",
                this.appliedStrokeStyle = "",
                this.currentLineWidth = "",
                this.appliedLineWidth = "",
                this.currentLineCap = "",
                this.appliedLineCap = "",
                this.currentLineJoin = "",
                this.appliedLineJoin = "",
                this.appliedMiterLimit = "",
                this.currentMiterLimit = ""
            }
            CVContextData.prototype.duplicate = function() {
                var ta = this._length * 2
                  , Cn = 0;
                for (Cn = this._length; Cn < ta; Cn += 1)
                    this.stack[Cn] = new CanvasContext;
                this._length = ta
            }
            ,
            CVContextData.prototype.reset = function() {
                this.cArrPos = 0,
                this.cTr.reset(),
                this.stack[this.cArrPos].opacity = 1
            }

            CVContextData.prototype.restore = function(ta) {
                this.cArrPos -= 1;
                var Cn = this.stack[this.cArrPos], na = Cn.transform, sa, oa = this.cTr.props;
                for (sa = 0; sa < 16; sa += 1)
                    oa[sa] = na[sa];
                if (ta) {
                    this.nativeContext.restore();
                    var la = this.stack[this.cArrPos + 1];
                    this.appliedFillStyle = la.fillStyle,
                    this.appliedStrokeStyle = la.strokeStyle,
                    this.appliedLineWidth = la.lineWidth,
                    this.appliedLineCap = la.lineCap,
                    this.appliedLineJoin = la.lineJoin,
                    this.appliedMiterLimit = la.miterLimit
                }
                this.nativeContext.setTransform(na[0], na[1], na[4], na[5], na[12], na[13]),
                (ta || Cn.opacity !== -1 && this.currentOpacity !== Cn.opacity) && (this.nativeContext.globalAlpha = Cn.opacity,
                this.currentOpacity = Cn.opacity),
                this.currentFillStyle = Cn.fillStyle,
                this.currentStrokeStyle = Cn.strokeStyle,
                this.currentLineWidth = Cn.lineWidth,
                this.currentLineCap = Cn.lineCap,
                this.currentLineJoin = Cn.lineJoin,
                this.currentMiterLimit = Cn.miterLimit
            }

            CVContextData.prototype.save = function(ta) {
                ta && this.nativeContext.save();
                var Cn = this.cTr.props;
                this._length <= this.cArrPos && this.duplicate();
                var na = this.stack[this.cArrPos], sa;
                for (sa = 0; sa < 16; sa += 1)
                    na.transform[sa] = Cn[sa];
                this.cArrPos += 1;
                var oa = this.stack[this.cArrPos];
                oa.opacity = na.opacity,
                oa.fillStyle = na.fillStyle,
                oa.strokeStyle = na.strokeStyle,
                oa.lineWidth = na.lineWidth,
                oa.lineCap = na.lineCap,
                oa.lineJoin = na.lineJoin,
                oa.miterLimit = na.miterLimit
            }

            HShapeElement.prototype.getBoundsOfCurve = function(ta, Cn, na, sa) {
                for (var oa = [[ta[0], sa[0]], [ta[1], sa[1]]], la, Sa, wa, ja, Na, Fa, Da, Ka = 0; Ka < 2; ++Ka)
                    Sa = 6 * ta[Ka] - 12 * Cn[Ka] + 6 * na[Ka],
                    la = -3 * ta[Ka] + 9 * Cn[Ka] - 9 * na[Ka] + 3 * sa[Ka],
                    wa = 3 * Cn[Ka] - 3 * ta[Ka],
                    Sa |= 0,
                    la |= 0,
                    wa |= 0,
                    la === 0 && Sa === 0 || (la === 0 ? (ja = -wa / Sa,
                    ja > 0 && ja < 1 && oa[Ka].push(this.calculateF(ja, ta, Cn, na, sa, Ka))) : (Na = Sa * Sa - 4 * wa * la,
                    Na >= 0 && (Fa = (-Sa + bmSqrt(Na)) / (2 * la),
                    Fa > 0 && Fa < 1 && oa[Ka].push(this.calculateF(Fa, ta, Cn, na, sa, Ka)),
                    Da = (-Sa - bmSqrt(Na)) / (2 * la),
                    Da > 0 && Da < 1 && oa[Ka].push(this.calculateF(Da, ta, Cn, na, sa, Ka)))));
                this.shapeBoundingBox.left = bmMin.apply(null, oa[0]),
                this.shapeBoundingBox.top = bmMin.apply(null, oa[1]),
                this.shapeBoundingBox.right = bmMax.apply(null, oa[0]),
                this.shapeBoundingBox.bottom = bmMax.apply(null, oa[1])
            }

            HShapeElement.prototype.calculateF = function(ta, Cn, na, sa, oa, la) {
                return bmPow(1 - ta, 3) * Cn[la] + 3 * bmPow(1 - ta, 2) * ta * na[la] + 3 * (1 - ta) * bmPow(ta, 2) * sa[la] + bmPow(ta, 3) * oa[la]
            }

                } else

                Cn.y -= na,
                Cn.yMax += na
            }

class MarketAPIController extends BaseApiController {
    async getCollections() {
        return (await this.api.get("/v1/market/collections")).data
    }
    async getItems(Cn) {
        const sa = Cn ? (Sa => {
            const wa = [];
            return Object.entries(Sa).forEach( ([ja,Na]) => {
                Array.isArray(Na) ? Na.forEach(Fa => {
                    wa.push(`${encodeURIComponent(ja)}=${encodeURIComponent(Fa)}`)
                }
                ) : Na != null && wa.push(`${encodeURIComponent(ja)}=${encodeURIComponent(Na)}`)
            }
            ),
            wa.join("&")
        }
        )(Cn) : ""
          , oa = sa ? `/v1/market/items?${sa}` : "/v1/market/items";
        return (await this.api.get(oa)).data
    }
    async getItemsByCollectionSlug(Cn) {
        const sa = Cn ? (Sa => {
            const wa = [];
            return Object.entries(Sa).forEach( ([ja,Na]) => {
                Array.isArray(Na) ? Na.forEach(Fa => {
                    wa.push(`${encodeURIComponent(ja)}=${encodeURIComponent(Fa)}`)
                }
                ) : Na != null && wa.push(`${encodeURIComponent(ja)}=${encodeURIComponent(Na)}`)
            }
            ),
            wa.join("&")
        }
        )(Cn) : ""
          , oa = sa ? `/v1/market/items?${sa}` : "/v1/market/items";
        return (await this.api.get(oa)).data
    }
    async buyItem(Cn) {
        var na;
        try {
            const sa = await this.api.post(`/v1/market/items/${Cn}/buy`);
            try {
                await userAPI.refreshBalanceCache()
            } catch (oa) {
                console.warn("Failed to refresh balance cache after purchase:", oa)
            }
            return sa.data
        } catch (sa) {
            if ((na = sa.response) != null && na.data) {
                const oa = sa.response.data;
                throw new Error(oa.detail || "Failed to buy item")
            }
            throw new Error("Failed to buy item")
        }
    }
}

class ReferralAPIController extends BaseApiController {
    async getReferralHistory() {
        var Cn;
        try {
            return (await this.api.get("/v1/referral/history")).data
        } catch (na) {
            if ((Cn = na.response) != null && Cn.data) {
                const sa = na.response.data;
                throw new Error(sa.detail || "Failed to fetch referral history")
            }
            throw new Error("Failed to fetch referral history")
        }
    }
    async getReferralData() {
        var Cn;
        try {
            return (await this.api.get("/v1/referral")).data
        } catch (na) {
            if ((Cn = na.response) != null && Cn.data) {
                const sa = na.response.data;
                throw new Error(sa.detail || "Failed to fetch referral data")
            }
            throw new Error("Failed to fetch referral data")
        }
    }
    async getLevelsList() {
        var Cn;
        try {
            return (await this.api.get("/v1/referral/levels")).data
        } catch (na) {
            if ((Cn = na.response) != null && Cn.data) {
                const sa = na.response.data;
                throw new Error(sa.detail || "Failed to fetch referral levels")
            }
            throw new Error("Failed to fetch referral levels")
        }
    }
    async withdrawReferralBalance() {
        var Cn;
        try {
            const sa = await this.api.post("/v1/referral/withdraw");
            return await userAPI.refreshBalanceCache(),
            sa.data
        } catch (na) {
            if ((Cn = na.response) != null && Cn.data) {
                const sa = na.response.data;
                throw new Error(sa.detail || "Failed to withdraw balance")
            }
            throw new Error("Failed to withdraw balance")
        }
    }
}

class CasesApiController extends BaseApiController {
    async getCasesList(Cn={}) {
        try {
            const na = serializeQueryParams(Cn);
            return (await this.api.get(`/v1/cases${na}`)).data
        } catch (na) {
            throw this.handleError(na, "Failed to fetch cases")
        }
    }
    async getTrendingCase() {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get("/v1/cases/popular")).data
        } catch (Cn) {
            throw this.handleError(Cn, "Failed to fetch trending case")
        }
    }
    async getCaseInfo(Cn) {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get(`/v1/cases/${Cn}`)).data
        } catch (na) {
            throw this.handleError(na, "Failed to fetch single case")
        }
    }
    async getCasePrizes(Cn) {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get(`/v1/cases/${Cn}/prizes`)).data
        } catch (na) {
            throw this.handleError(na, "Failed to fetch case prizes")
        }
    }
    async getDailyCaseStrike(Cn) {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get(`/v1/cases/${Cn}/strike`)).data
        } catch (na) {
            throw this.handleError(na, "Failed to fetch case prizes")
        }
    }
    async openCase(Cn, na) {
        try {
            return (await this.api.post(`/v1/cases/${Cn}${na ? "?demo=true" : ""}`)).data
        } catch (sa) {
            throw this.handleError(sa, "Failed to open case")
        }
    }
    async getCaseTasks(Cn) {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get(`/v1/cases/${Cn}/tasks`)).data
        } catch (na) {
            throw this.handleError(na, "Failed to fetch case tasks to open")
        }
    }
    async getCasesWinnersHistory(Cn) {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get(`/v1/cases/history${Cn ? "?case_id=" + Cn : ""}`)).data
        } catch (na) {
            throw this.handleError(na, "Failed to fetch case winners history")
        }
    }
    async checkCaseTasks(Cn) {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get(`/v1/cases/${Cn}/check`)).data
        } catch (na) {
            throw this.handleError(na, "Failed to fetch case tasks check")
        }
    }
    async getDepositCaseInfo() {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get("/v1/cases/special/deposit")).data
        } catch (Cn) {
            throw this.handleError(Cn, "Failed to fetch deposit case info")
        }
    }
    async getDepositCaseLevelsInfo() {
        try {
            return (await this.api.get("/v1/cases/special/deposit/levels")).data
        } catch (Cn) {
            throw this.handleError(Cn, "Failed to fetch deposit case levels info")
        }
    }
}
